factValues.name: gr:fact-24b5d41ce9d807b0_fv
factValues.value: The principal activity of the company is the operation of electric vehicle charging points.

factValues.name: gr:fact-25fb1e3f27faec8b_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared and delivered in accordance with the provisions applicable to companies subject to the small companies regime.

factValues.name: gr:fact-ccf1b201dcfea96d_fv
factValues.value: As permitted by section 444 (5A) of the Companies Act 2006, the directors have not delivered to the registrar a copy of the Profit and Loss Account.

factValues.name: gr:fact-9244e619d79c529d_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared in accordance with Financial Reporting Standard 102 Section 1A smaller entities - 'The Financial Reporting Standard applicable in the United Kingdom and Republic of Ireland' and the Companies Act 2006 (as applicable to companies subject to the small companies' regime).

factValues.name: gr:fact-09683396f5899dfa_fv
factValues.value: These financial statements have been prepared using the historical cost convention except that as disclosed in the accounting policies certain items are shown at fair value.These financial statements are prepared in Sterling, which is the functional currency of the company. All monetary amounts are rounded to the nearest £.

factValues.name: gr:fact-c8705dd320e6a51f_fv
factValues.value: The Independent Auditor's Report was unqualified.

factValues.name: gr:fact-d53995e3b82e93af_fv
factValues.value: In the application of the company's accounting policies, the directors are required to make judgements, estimates and assumptions about the carrying amount of assets and liabilities that are not readily apparent from other sources. The estimates and associated assumptions are based on historical experience and other factors that are considered to be relevant. Actual results may differ from these estimates.The estimates and underlying assumptions are reviewed on an ongoing basis. Revisions to accounting estimates are recognised in the period in which the estimate is revised where revision affects only that period, or in the period of revision and future periods where the revision affects both current and future periods.

factValues.name: gr:fact-a3bf919724bb40c3_fv
gr:fact-bff2ed3ff850f523_fv
factValues.value:
Transactions in foreign currencies are initially recorded at the functional currency rate prevailing at the date of the transaction. Monetary assets and liabilities denominated in foreign currencies are retranslated into the respective functional currency of the entity at the rates prevailing on the reporting period date. Non-monetary items carried at fair value that are denominated in foreign currencies are retranslated at the rate on the date when the fair value is re-measured.
 
 Non-monetary items measured in terms of historical cost in a foreign currency are not retranslated.

factValues.name: gr:fact-0044012b21f8f6c7_fv
factValues.value: The tax expense for the period comprises current tax. Tax is recognised in profit or loss, except that a change attributable to an item of income or expense recognised as other comprehensive income is also recognised directly in other comprehensive income.

factValues.name: gr:fact-cc96a8ae5cb6376a_fv
factValues.value: The current tax charge is calculated on the basis of tax rates and laws that have been enacted or substantively enacted by the reporting date in the countries where the company operates and generates taxable income.

factValues.name: gr:fact-e070b3655000fc99_fv
factValues.value:
Tangible assets are stated in the balance sheet at cost, less any subsequent accumulated depreciation and subsequent accumulated impairment losses.
 
 The cost of tangible assets includes directly attributable incremental costs incurred in their acquisition and installation.
